chapterInfo.content:
1
Ahonu ho kɔkɔbɔ
1 # Esra 5.1 Dario afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu no, bosome a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe mu no, AWURADE asɛm baa Odiyifoɔ Sakaria a ɔyɛ Berekia ba Ido ba nkyɛn, sɛ: 2Abohuro na AWURADE bo huru tiaa mo agyanom. 3#Mal 3.7; Yak 4.8 Na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Monsane mmra me nkyɛn, na mɛsane maba mo nkyɛn, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ. 4#Yer 3.12; Hes 3.11 Monnyɛ sɛ mo agyanom a kane adiyifoɔ no pae kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Monsane mfiri mo akwammɔne ne mo nneyɛɛ bɔne no ho, nanso wɔante, na me nso, wɔantie me, AWURADE asɛm nie. 5Mo agyanom no wɔ he? Na adiyifoɔ no, wɔtena hɔ kɔsi daa? 6Nanso me nsɛm ne m’ahyɛdeɛ a mehyɛɛ me nkoa adiyifoɔ no no, anto mo agyanom anaa? Na wɔsanee na wɔkaa sɛ: Sɛdeɛ asafo AWURADE dwene sɛ ɔbɛyɛ yɛn sɛdeɛ yɛn akwan ne yɛn nneyɛɛ teɛ no, saa na ɔne yɛn adi no.
Onyankopɔn dɔ Sion
7Bosome a ɛtɔ so dubaako a ɛne bosome Sebat da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nnan, Dario afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu mu, AWURADE asɛm baa Odiyifoɔ Sakaria a ɔyɛ Berekia ba Ido ba nkyɛn sɛ: 8#Sak 6.1-8 Mehunuu anadwo, na hwɛ, na ɔbarima bi te ɔpɔnkɔ kɔkɔɔ so, na ɔgyina ohwamdua a ɛwɔ bonhwa mu no ntam, na apɔnkɔ akɔkɔɔ, ntokontrama ne afufuo gyinagyina n’akyi. Na mebisaa sɛ: Me wura, yeinom yɛ deɛn? 9Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔrekasa akyerɛ me no ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Merebɛkyerɛ wo adekodeɛ a yeinom yɛ. 10Na ɔbarima a ɔgyina ohwamdua no ntam no buaa sɛ: Yeinom na AWURADE asoma wɔn sɛ wɔnkɔkyini asase soɔ. 11Na wɔbuaa AWURADE bɔfoɔ a ɔgyina ohwamdua no ntam no sɛ: Yɛakyini asase so, na hwɛ, asase nyinaa te hɔ komm dwoodwoo. 12#Dwom 102.13; Dan 9.2 Ɛnna AWURADE bɔfoɔ no bisaa sɛ: Asafo AWURADE, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na wo yam renhyehye wo mma Yerusalem ne Yuda nkuro a wo bo ahuro atia wɔn mfirinhyia aduɔson nie? 13Na AWURADE de nsɛm pa ne awerɛkyekyerɛ nsɛm buaa ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔne me kasaeɛ no. 14Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔne me kasaeɛ no ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Pae ka sɛ: Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Ninkunu kɛseɛ na matwe no Yerusalem ne Sion ho, 15#Yes 47.6 na abohuro kɛseɛ na me bo huru tia amanaman a wɔte hɔ dwoodwoo no, ɛfiri sɛ me deɛ, me bo huruu kakraa bi, na wɔn deɛ, wɔboae maa no danee bɔne. 16#Sak 8.3 Enti sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Mede ayamhyehyeɛ madane m’ani akyerɛ Yerusalem, ɛhɔ na wɔbɛsi me fie nso, asafo AWURADE asɛm nie, na wɔbɛtwe susuhoma mu Yerusalem so. 17#Yes 40.1-2; 14.1 Pae mu bio ka sɛ: Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Nnepa bɛbu so me nkuro mu, na AWURADE bɛkɔ so akyekyere Sion werɛ, na ɔbɛkɔ so afa Yerusalem ayɛ ne deɛ.
Mmɛn nnan ne atomfoɔ baanan ho asɛm
18Na memaa m’ani so mehwɛe, na hwɛ, na mmɛn nnan nie. 19Na mebisaa ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔne me kasaeɛ no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn ne yeinom? Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Yeinom ne mmɛn a ɛbɔɔ Yuda, Israel ne Yerusalem peteeɛ no. 20Na AWURADE kyerɛɛ me atomfoɔ baanan. 21Na mebisaa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na yeinom bɛyɛeɛ? Na ɔse: Yeinom ne mmɛn a ɛbɔɔ Yuda peteeɛ na obi amma ne tiri soɔ no, na atomfoɔ baanan no baa wɔn ehuyie, sɛ wɔbɛtutu amanaman a wɔmaa abɛn so tiaa Yuda asase de bɔɔ wɔn peteeɛ no mmɛn.

Na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Monsane mmra me nkyɛn, na mɛsane maba mo nkyɛn, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ. Bosome a ɛtɔ so dubaako a ɛne bosome Sebat da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nnan, Dario afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu mu, AWURADE asɛm baa Odiyifoɔ Sakaria a ɔyɛ Berekia ba Ido ba nkyɛn sɛ: Mehunuu anadwo, na hwɛ, na ɔbarima bi te ɔpɔnkɔ kɔkɔɔ so, na ɔgyina ohwamdua a ɛwɔ bonhwa mu no ntam, na apɔnkɔ akɔkɔɔ, ntokontrama ne afufuo gyinagyina n’akyi. Na ɔbarima a ɔgyina ohwamdua no ntam no buaa sɛ: Yeinom na AWURADE asoma wɔn sɛ wɔnkɔkyini asase soɔ. Na wɔbuaa AWURADE bɔfoɔ a ɔgyina ohwamdua no ntam no sɛ: Yɛakyini asase so, na hwɛ, asase nyinaa te hɔ komm dwoodwoo. Ɛnna AWURADE bɔfoɔ no bisaa sɛ: Asafo AWURADE, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na wo yam renhyehye wo mma Yerusalem ne Yuda nkuro a wo bo ahuro atia wɔn mfirinhyia aduɔson nie? Na AWURADE de nsɛm pa ne awerɛkyekyerɛ nsɛm buaa ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔne me kasaeɛ no. Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔne me kasaeɛ no ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Pae ka sɛ: Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Ninkunu kɛseɛ na matwe no Yerusalem ne Sion ho, na abohuro kɛseɛ na me bo huru tia amanaman a wɔte hɔ dwoodwoo no, ɛfiri sɛ me deɛ, me bo huruu kakraa bi, na wɔn deɛ, wɔboae maa no danee bɔne. Enti sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Mede ayamhyehyeɛ madane m’ani akyerɛ Yerusalem, ɛhɔ na wɔbɛsi me fie nso, asafo AWURADE asɛm nie, na wɔbɛtwe susuhoma mu Yerusalem so. Na memaa m’ani so mehwɛe, na hwɛ, na mmɛn nnan nie. Na mebisaa ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔne me kasaeɛ no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn ne yeinom? Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Yeinom ne mmɛn a ɛbɔɔ Yuda, Israel ne Yerusalem peteeɛ no. Na AWURADE kyerɛɛ me atomfoɔ baanan. Na mebisaa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na yeinom bɛyɛeɛ? Na ɔse: Yeinom ne mmɛn a ɛbɔɔ Yuda peteeɛ na obi amma ne tiri soɔ no, na atomfoɔ baanan no baa wɔn ehuyie, sɛ wɔbɛtutu amanaman a wɔmaa abɛn so tiaa Yuda asase de bɔɔ wɔn peteeɛ no mmɛn.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
